ciscer.taglineEn: Dual-gene methylation test, empowering cervical cancer prevention
ciscer.summaryEn: PAX1/JAM3 dual-gene combined test using non-invasive cervical exfoliated cell sampling, accurately identifying CIN2+ high-grade lesions for precise triage.
targetPopulationEn: Cervical cancer screening for postmenopausal women
Treatment response and recurrence monitoring for cervical lesions
scenariosEn: Opportunistic and population-based cervical cancer screening
Colposcopy referral decisions after HPV-positive results
Post-treatment follow-up for high-grade cervical lesions
Women's health dual-screening programs at health checkup centers
highlightsEn: Dual-gene (PAX1/JAM3) combined test with superior performance
Supported by multi-center study data with 10,000+ paired cases
Recommended by multiple domestic and international expert consensus and guidelines
hospitalsEn: Obstetrics & Gynecology Hospital of Fudan University
Women's Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine

cisendo.taglineEn: World's first non-invasive endometrial cancer screening, filling a clinical gap
cisendo.summaryEn: CDO1/CELF4 dual-gene methylation test using non-invasive sampling to replace invasive biopsy — the world's first non-invasive endometrial cancer screening, filling a clinical gap.
targetPopulationEn: Endometrial cancer screening for postmenopausal women
Endometrial pathology risk assessment for perimenopausal women
scenariosEn: Non-invasive early screening for endometrial cancer
Pre-hysteroscopy risk stratification to reduce unnecessary invasive procedures
Follow-up and monitoring for high-risk populations
Women's health screening programs at health checkup centers
highlightsEn: World's first non-invasive endometrial cancer methylation test
Global patents, CE certification, and Malaysia registration
Recommended by the Chinese Expert Consensus on Three-Tier Prevention Strategies for Endometrial Cancer
Recommended by the Expert Consensus on Clinical Application of Gene Methylation Screening for Endometrial Cancer
hospitalsEn: Obstetrics & Gynecology Hospital of Fudan University
Women's Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine

cisova.taglineEn: A single blood draw to detect early ovarian cancer
cisova.summaryEn: CDO1/HOXA9 dual-gene methylation test requiring only a single peripheral blood ctDNA draw — non-invasive auxiliary diagnosis, solving the challenge of early detection of the 'silent killer.'
targetPopulationEn: Benign/malignant differentiation for women with ovarian cysts or pelvic masses
Early risk assessment for high-risk ovarian cancer populations
Ovarian health screening for peri- and postmenopausal women
Auxiliary diagnosis for suspected ovarian cancer patients
scenariosEn: Non-invasive early screening for ovarian cancer
Benign/malignant stratification of pelvic masses to aid surgical decisions
Follow-up monitoring for high-risk ovarian cancer populations
Women's cancer screening programs at health checkup centers
highlightsEn: China's first approved ovarian cancer methylation test product
Requires only a single blood draw with excellent patient compliance
ctDNA-based epigenetic testing — non-invasive and precise
Global patents and proprietary intellectual property
hospitalsEn: Obstetrics & Gynecology Hospital of Fudan University
